overview: The Cent Kalyani Scheme is a loan product offered by Central Bank of India specifically designed to support women entrepreneurs in establishing or expanding their business ventures. It provides financial assistance through term loans to eligible women entrepreneurs for various business purposes including working capital, asset creation, and business expansion. The scheme aims to promote women's entrepreneurship and economic empowerment by offering accessible credit facilities with favorable terms.
objectives: To provide financial assistance to women entrepreneurs for starting or expanding business ventures
To promote women's entrepreneurship and economic empowerment
To support business growth through accessible credit facilities
To encourage self-employment and income generation among women
To contribute to the development of women-led MSMEs
eligibility: Women entrepreneurs who are Indian nationals, aged 18 years and above, with KYC-compliant accounts with Central Bank of India. The scheme is applicable to women engaged in manufacturing, service, trading, or agricultural activities. Applicants must have a viable business project and demonstrate repayment capacity. Existing Central Bank of India customers with satisfactory account conduct are preferred.
benefits: Financial support through term loans for business purposes, no collateral requirement for loans up to a certain limit (as per CGTMSE coverage), competitive interest rates, flexible repayment tenure, and support for various business activities including working capital, asset creation, and business expansion. The scheme also offers guidance and support through the bank's MSME and women entrepreneur cell.
financial_support: The scheme provides term loans to women entrepreneurs with loan quantum determined based on project viability and repayment capacity. While specific loan limits are not detailed in the evidence, the scheme operates under the bank's general lending policies for MSMEs. Loans may be covered under CGTMSE for collateral-free lending up to specified limits. Interest rates are linked to external benchmarks like MCLR/RBLR with applicable spreads.
application_process: 1. Visit the nearest Central Bank of India branch or access the bank's online portal. 2. Inquire about the Cent Kalyani Scheme for women entrepreneurs. 3. Obtain and fill the loan application form. 4. Submit the application along with required documents including KYC, business plan, and financial projections. 5. Bank officials will verify documents and assess project viability. 6. Upon approval, loan sanction letter will be issued. 7. Complete legal formalities and disbursement will be made as per agreed terms.
required_documents: Any licenses/registrations related to the business
contact_details: Toll Free Number - 1800 30 30 - for all | Toll Free Number - 18002031911 - Exclusively for Pensioner
caveats: Loan approval is subject to credit assessment and project viability
Repayment capacity is a key factor in loan sanction
Specific terms and conditions including interest rates, tenure, and margin are subject to change based on bank policy
Loans above certain limits may require collateral or third-party guarantee
Beneficiaries must maintain satisfactory account conduct with the bank
